telemetry.address: 20816 President Point Rd NE, Kingston, WA 98346, USA

geology.formation: Vashon Glacial Till over Esperance Sand and Lawton Clay
geology.stratigraphy: Unsorted glacial deposit containing compacted clay, silt, sand, and gravel over deep marine glacial lacustrine beds
geology.topography: Steep Puget Sound coastal bluff dropping eastward directly into a cobble/pebble drift beach, perched coastal terrace above the shoreline
geology.hydrology: High bluff seepage, marine cliff groundwater runoff towards Admiralty Inlet/Puget Sound, moist coastal soil with dense organic duff

structures.type: Multi-level Coastal Residence with Observation Turret / Clerestory

materials.facade: Weathered cedar shingle and vertical tongue-and-groove siding with painted white timber fascia and deck supports
materials.roof: Multi-gabled architectural asphalt shingles with lead flashing and elevated glass viewing cupola
materials.foundation: Poured reinforced concrete on stepped bluff footings

materials.facade: Painted horizontal lap siding with white framed double-hung windows
White-washed wood siding, batten seams, ground-level timber bay doors
materials.roof: Gabled standing seam or asphalt shingle roof

materials.facade: Natural cedar siding and painted trim

properties.hardscape: Compacted earth and crushed gravel access driveway, timber retaining bulkheads, wooden perimeter guardrails along the bluff edge

properties.canopy_composition: Dense Pacific Northwest coastal temperate rainforest: mature Pseudotsuga menziesii (Douglas-fir), Thuja plicata (Western Red Cedar), Acer macrophyllum (Bigleaf Maple), and Alnus rubra (Red Alder)
properties.understory: Polystichum munitum (Sword Fern), Gaultheria shallon (Salal), Rubus spectabilis (Salmonberry), and coastal mosses clinging to damp bark and loam
properties.coastal_ecotone: Sandy/gravel bluff face with rooted dune grass, sea-drifted logs, and salt-spray-hardened shoreline shrubs

properties.illumination: Crisp morning maritime daylight with low Pacific Northwest sun penetrating through dense conifer canopy
properties.haze_and_aerosol: Moist Puget Sound marine air, soft coastal mist hanging over the tree line, mild salt-air diffusion
properties.shadow_characteristics: Dappled, directional tree shadows extending westward across the dry gravel yard and timber structures
